authorizes: confirmatory preparation only; real-spend runs require explicit owner approval; default-on requires a confirmatory decision and owner approval
question: On quota routes, does cold-point routing with the local Laya judge reduce strong-model tokens without a meaningful loss of task success, compared with always-strong?
decisionRule: PR 17 default-on only if H1 through H5, the screens (no warm turn judged, zero lost turns, zero invariant failures), and the Laya replay gate all pass; otherwise off, shadow recommended.

gapDistribution.interiorAnchors: interpolated; replaceable only before the calibration run
gapDistribution.perTrialSeed: derived per (task, repeat) from the experiment --gap-seed so paired arms share the trial's gaps

operatingPoint.selectionRule: the threshold and margin that maximize coverage subject to false-downgrade <= 10% and coverage >= 15% of cold points on the replay curve

layaGate.eceFallback: thresholds read only from the replay curve when ECE exceeds 0.10

provisional.note: provisional overlays never carry calibratedBy: the router treats its presence as calibrated, so only replay-judges.mjs writes the id, the threshold, and the margin together on a passed gate

operatingPoint.writtenBefore: any confirmatory trial; the runner refuses confirmatory runs unless the registration has replayGate passed, the overlay's calibratedBy equals the registration's, and the overlay values equal the registration's

randomMatched.rule: a seeded draw per consult selects the candidate with probability p equal to R's realized entry rate at cold points in the calibration run
randomMatched.draw: u = hash(seed, sessionId, turn, step); deterministic and replayable without state; answers carry probability 1 and confidence 1

cacheIsolation.armOrder: seeded shuffle per task via --arm-seed; seed pinned in the run manifest
cacheIsolation.nonce: --nonce appends a logged, model-visible nonce line to each trial's first user message

h1.method: cluster-robust (CR1) by task on paired success differences
h1.hardStratum: H1 must also pass within the hard stratum: a separate CR1 bound over hard-task pairs only. Missing or insufficient hard data (fewer than two hard tasks with pairs) records hard.status 'insufficient-data' and refuses the pass instead of defaulting.
h1.moduleRule: computeRoutingGate: H1.pass = overall bound AND evaluated hard-stratum bound both above -delta

power.underpoweredRule: observed p_disc above the level's design value cannot pass H1 at that level

secondaries.holm: family alpha 0.05 over H2-H5 one-sided p-values

L2.staged: L1's first 120 pairs first; stop-for-harm boundary preregistered with O'Brien-Fleming spending before stage 1

L3.decides: GO/NO-GO with margin, plus T vs S at 180 pairs (exploratory)
L3.extra: C x3 and T x3; real gaps over 1 hour

ownerDecisionsPending: TTL probe (§2.1.1): long vs 5-minute posture statement

strong.provenance: id proven as claude-session subscription id and price row only; metered pi-ai profile hand-declared from spec metadata (1M/128k, adaptive thinking, no temperature); API acceptance on a metered key UNPROVEN until the owner-approved first real run

cheap.provenance: the only id the adapter declares; billed at V4.1-Flash rates through the 2026-09-26 alias snapshot row; deepseek-v4.1-flash stays unresolved

priceSnapshotAlias.derived: verbatim copy of the 2026-09-24 deepseek-v4.1-flash row with a citing note; published snapshots are never edited

armT.composition: initialMode on, routeFrom Opus, childPolicies judge:false, NO judgment service composed
armT.rationale: shadow means no request is rewritten, children included; a shadow parent with live children is rejected (aegis §10.2)
armT.audit: zero downgraded main-conversation decisions; at least one routed child-decision per delegating task
